text: Carpentry is the craft of creating structures and objects from wood and other materials. It is a diverse field that includes furniture assembly and house construction. Carpenters utilize joints, which are essential to provide structural integrity. Various types of joints, such as the mortise and tenon, dovetail, and scarf joints, are employed. The construction of these joints demands specific techniques and tools. The assembly of joints ensures the stability and durability of the object. After the joints are complete, the object can be finished with a protective coating, a varnish, which enhances its appearance and prevents decay or damage.
